title: 第400章 咄咄怪事第399章 死
slug: 长生从守书阁的太监开始
lines: 一股更深的寒意攫住了他的心脏。
他猛地完全转过身！
只见就在他身后不足五步之处，一道瘦削的身影，不知何时，悄无声息地站在那里。
正是刘锋！
他的脖子上，那道被自己弯刀砍出的、本应致命的伤口，依旧清晰可见！
饶是独眼杀人如麻、凶悍残忍，此刻也被这超出理解范畴的恐怖一幕吓得魂飞魄散！
他发出一声不似人声的、破了音的凄厉尖叫，浑身汗毛倒竖，头皮发麻，握着弯刀的手都不受控制地剧烈颤抖起来！
将全身力气灌注于手臂，手中那柄沾过无数鲜血的银亮弯刀，带着凄厉的破空声，再次狠狠砍向眼前这“死而复生”的怪物！这一次，他瞄准的是脖颈——他要将这诡异的脑袋彻底砍下来！
一声完全不似砍中血肉之躯的、沉闷而巨大的金铁交鸣之声，骤然炸响！火星在刀锋与脖颈接触的瞬间迸溅！
独眼只觉得自己这一刀仿佛砍在了一座铁山之上！
一股无可抵御的、沛然莫御的反震之力顺着刀身猛地传来，震得他虎口崩裂，五指发麻，整条手臂的骨头都像要寸寸碎裂！
“哐当！”
银亮的弯刀再也握持不住，脱手飞出，撞在土墙上，又弹落在地，发出无力的哀鸣。
他脖颈被砍中的地方，那狰狞的伤口依旧，莫说新的伤痕，甚至连一道白印都未曾留下。
他只是微微偏了偏头，仿佛只是被一只烦人的蚊蝇轻轻触碰了一下。
那双漠然的眼睛，依旧平静地看着独眼，那抹厌恶之色，更深了几分。
独眼呆立当场，如同被施了定身法。
他仅剩的独眼瞪大到极限，充满了无法理解的惊骇与绝望。
刀枪不入？不坏之身？这到底是什么怪物？！
一声极轻、极淡，仿佛穿越了无尽时空、带着无尽疲惫与一丝了然无奈的叹息，从刘峰口中逸出。
这叹息声不大，却奇异地压过了屋外隐约的喧嚣，清晰地传入独眼耳中，让他最后的意识都为之一清。
五指微握，成拳。
没有风声，没有光影，没有惊天动地的气势。
那只拳头，就这么平平无奇地，向前递出。
在独眼的视野中，那只拳头仿佛在无限放大，填满了他的整个瞳孔，乃至整个灵魂。
时间、空间、声音、光影……一切的一切，都在这一拳之下，失去了意义。
独眼发出生命中最后一声无声的呐喊。
拳头，轻轻印在了他的胸口。
没有巨响，没有血肉横飞。
独眼魁梧的身躯，如同被阳光直射的冰雪，又像被橡皮擦去的炭笔痕迹，从被拳头击中的胸口开始，无声无息地、迅速地融化消散。
content_en:
;;
A deeper chill gripped his heart.
He turned around completely!
He saw a thin figure less than five steps behind him, standing there quietly at some point.
It's Liu Feng!
On his neck, the supposed fatal wound made by his scimitar was still clearly visible!
"Ghost...ghost-!!!"
Even though he was one-eyed and murderous, he was fierce and cruel, but at this moment he was frightened out of his wits by this terrifying scene beyond his comprehension!
He let out a shrill scream that was not like a human voice and broke the sound. The hairs all over his body stood on end, his scalp was numb, and the hand holding the scimitar trembled violently uncontrollably!
He poured all his strength into his arm, and with the bright silver scimitar stained with countless blood in his hand, with a shrill sound of breaking through the air, he slashed hard at the "resurrected" monster in front of him again! This time, he aimed at the neck - he wanted to completely chop off this weird head!
"Dang——!!!"
There was a sudden explosion! Sparks flew out the moment the blade came into contact with the neck!
One Eye only felt as if his sword had struck an iron mountain!
An irresistible and overwhelming counter-shock force suddenly came along the blade of the blade, causing his jaw to crack, his fingers to go numb, and the bones of his entire arm to shatter inch by inch!
"Clang!"
The shiny silver scimitar could no longer be held, and flew out of his hand, hitting the earth wall, and then bounced to the ground, letting out a feeble whine.
Where his neck was slashed, the hideous wound remained. Not to mention new scars, not even a white mark was left.
He just tilted his head slightly, as if he had been lightly touched by an annoying mosquito.
Those indifferent eyes were still looking at the one-eye calmly, and the look of disgust became a little deeper.
One-eyed stood on the spot, as if a immobilization spell had been cast on him.
His remaining eye was widened to its limit, filled with incomprehensible horror and despair.
Invulnerable? Indestructible body? What kind of monster is this? !
"Alas..."
A very soft and indifferent sigh, which seemed to have traveled through endless time and space, with endless fatigue and a hint of helplessness, escaped from Liu Feng's mouth.
The sigh was not loud, but it strangely overcame the vague noise outside the house and reached One-Eye's ears clearly, making his last consciousness clear.
The five fingers are slightly clenched to form a fist.
There was no sound of wind, no light and shadow, and no earth-shattering momentum.
That fist was extended forward in an ordinary manner.
In One Eye's field of vision, the fist seemed to be expanding infinitely, filling his entire pupil and even his entire soul.
Time, space, sound, light and shadow... everything lost their meaning under this punch.
"No-!!!"
One-Eye let out the last silent cry of his life.
The fist lightly touched his chest.
There was no loud noise, no flying flesh.
The one-eyed burly body was like ice and snow exposed to direct sunlight, or like charcoal traces erased by an eraser. Starting from the chest hit by the fist, it melted and dissipated silently and quickly.
